purpose: check that the pinned G1 environment trains, evaluates and exports a phone-compatible detector end to end on CPU; the scores are meaningless (39 training images, 1 epoch)
command: prepare_coco.py --limit 32 --workers 8 (40 train + 10 development images downloaded, 117 boxes)

measured.ops: builtin only: ADD, CONCATENATION, CONV_2D, DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D, LOGISTIC, MUL, RELU6, RESHAPE, RESIZE_NEAREST_NEIGHBOR (+ QUANTIZE for int8, DEQUANTIZE for float16); no TFLite_Detection_PostProcess
measured.io: input 1x256x256x3 (float32 [-1,1]; uint8 for int8); outputs 12,276 raw box encodings and 15 sigmoid class scores; anchors and box-coder scales (1.0) in metadata.json
measured.product_detector_class_loads_export: yes: petperception.vision.detector.EfficientDetDetector loads model_float32.tflite and model_int8_ptq.tflite unchanged (anchors, scales, labels from the embedded metadata) and returns detections

problems_found_and_fixed: mediapipe 1.1.0 lacks mediapipe.tasks.cc used by Model Maker 0.2.1.4: pinned mediapipe==0.10.14 with numpy<2
quantization-aware training fails for MOBILENET_V2 (Conv2DBNBlock has no quantize config): int8 export switched to post-training quantization; QAT opt-in
not_done: browser parity of a trained G1 export (bundle export + engine parity)
